Great! apply_template returned a tuple of precursors: ('Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1', 'Nc1ccccc1N')

So first precursor is same phenyl-sulfonyl with carboxylic acid (instead of amide). The second is aniline (aniline). So template 324324 corresponds to amide formation? Actually it replaced the amide N with OH (carboxylic acid). So disconnection: target -> carboxylic acid precursor + aniline.

Thus our earlier assumption wrong. So we need to follow actual output.

Now we need to apply second template 1914396 to the carboxylic acid precursor (first precursor). Let's apply.
